findings.description: Derived Perp minus Spot spread was incorrectly used as a substitute for Mark Price, Index Price, and Premium Index.
findings.remediation: Ingest official Binance Vision archives: markPriceKlines, indexPriceKlines, and premiumIndexKlines. Explicitly differentiate trade_basis, mark_spot_basis, perp_index_basis, and official_premium_index.

findings.description: Liquidation proximity and margin requirements cannot be accurately evaluated using traded price; Binance liquidations trigger on official Mark Price.
findings.remediation: Enforce liquidation proximity and maintenance margin checks using official markPriceKlines.

findings.description: Estimating future funding settlement from traded spot/perp spread is noisy and ignores the official 8h TWAP formula of premium index.
findings.remediation: Use official premiumIndexKlines rolling 8h TWAP plus interest rate clamp for point-in-time funding rate forecasting.
